{{Top|leg}}
'''Monkey-Lizard Madness''' was a game that could be accessed through the [[JustiCam]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system located in the [[Justicars' computer lab]] within the [[Justicar territory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Encounter">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Wiped Clean|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Monkey-Lizard Madness was mentioned in the dynamic encounter mission "Wiped Clean" in the Justicars' database<ref name="Encounter" /> introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
